items.example: I looked along the shelf for Band-Aids while my colleague waited near the door.

dialog.en: Where do you keep the cold medicine?
Second shelf on the left, next to the tissues.

items.example: I bought a painkiller for my headache after staring at the laptop all afternoon.

dialog.en: Do you have anything for a headache?
We have this painkiller. It's the small box on the right.

items.example: I asked the pharmacist what would help my sore throat before the client meeting.

dialog.en: What seems to be the problem?
My throat has hurt since yesterday.

items.example: I handed the prescription to the pharmacist and waited around ten minutes.

dialog.en: Yes, the doctor wrote it this morning.

items.example: I asked the pharmacist about the dosage because I had to fly that evening.

dialog.en: How often should I take it?
One tablet every six hours, with water.

items.example: I paid at the checkout while the cashier counted my change.

dialog.en: Your total is twelve dollars and fifty cents.

items.example: I showed my insurance card, but the clerk said this medicine was sold over the counter.

dialog.en: No, I'll just use my card.

items.example: I picked up gauze and tape from the first aid display after my friend scraped her knee.

dialog.en: Where is your first aid section?
Right behind you, next to the bandages.
